methodology: 4608 public-command progression runs plus 12 waiting-investment counterchecks; 288 synthetic arena controls with exhaustive action branches (leaf counts are not win probabilities); 24 public-command expedition runs. 128 dispersed reproducible seeds per progression cell. No player-time claims.
